title: How Much Dependency Can a Marginal Rule See? Total Correlation in Diffusion LM Parallel Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.31990v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A masked diffusion language model is fast because it commits several tokens per step. Each token is sampled from its own marginal, so the dependency between the tokens is lost, and the size of that loss is the conditional total correlation C of the committed set. Most decoders choose the set from per-position marginals, which can bound C but cannot determine it. We ask how well they predict it. We estimate C for fixed candidate sets on four masked diffusion LMs from two families. On three of the four, the best marginal-only predictor is off by about one bit (0.74 to 1.17), 1.8 to 3.7 times less than a baseline that knows only the bound, and most of this accuracy comes from the bound itself. On a subset, our estimate ranks sets like the exact KL cost of a parallel commit, but sits a median 0.4 to 1.1 bits below it on prose and when the rest of the text is still masked. translated_title: 边缘规则能看到多少依赖性？扩散语言模型并行解码中的总相关性
translated_abstract: 掩码扩散语言模型之所以快速，是因为它在每一步提交多个token。每个token都是从其自身的边缘分布中采样的，因此token之间的依赖性丢失了，而该损失的大小就是所提交集合的条件总相关性 C。大多数解码器从每个位置的边缘分布中选择集合，这可以约束 C 但无法确定它。我们探讨了它们对 C 的预测能力如何。我们在来自两个家族的四个掩码扩散语言模型上估计固定候选集合的 C。在四个模型中的三个上，最佳的仅边缘预测器偏差约为一比特（0.74 到 1.17），比仅知道边界的基线好 1.8 到 3.7 倍，而这种准确性大部分来自边界本身。在一个子集上，我们的估计对集合的排序效果类似于并行提交的精确 KL 代价，但在散文文本上以及当文本其余部分仍被掩码时，比该代价中位数低 0.4 到 1.1 比特。Dream-instruct 是例外，主要体现在散文文本上，其条件……（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文量化了扩散语言模型并行解码中基于边缘分布的解码器对提交token集合条件总相关性（即依赖性损失）的预测能力，发现其预测准确性主要来源于边界本身，且估计值在散文文本上通常比精确 KL 代价低 0.4 到 1.1 比特。
en_tdlr: This paper quantifies how well marginal-based decoders in masked diffusion language models predict the conditional total correlation (dependency loss) of committed token sets during parallel decoding, finding that most prediction accuracy stems from the bound itself and that estimates sit a median 0.4 to 1.1 bits below the exact KL cost on prose text.
